lines.text: Your PM says it's just a table.
It's not. Every data table has three jobs.
Job one: find. People need the five rows that matter, not all five hundred.
So put the filters on the screen, not behind a button.
lines.card:
Filters on screen,
not behind a button.

lines.text: Job two: compare. Sort by the number that matters, and line the numbers up on the right.
Job three: act. Pick the rows, and the actions show up right there.
Most tables only do one of the three.
lines.card:
Most tables do
one of the three.

lines.text: Find. Compare. Act. Design for all three.
